label: B2 against brute contingency: two support options, the rival's entailed denials, symmetric parity
summary:
Reuse audit (truth related/brief/dossier on B2 8a8d00e9; index search 'brute existence'; local-no-brute-existence attempt, stopping-point and PSR strength maps, #756 and #746 notes, a5958e25) found no existing PSR-family statement that yields B2 alone: reason tokens do not convert to causes without a bridge. Two non-transcription support options for B2 on the shared CausalityFrame were registered and verified (Comparator and NanoDa): (1) 7bf9cb77, the contingent-only local existence PSR 608a262d with BX1 6c6191dc (no reason for a contingent being's existence is about itself) and BX2 0e44041e (the other being such a reason is about causes its esse); (2) 19260537, the existing grounding closure c71c068c with the existing ground-to-esse-cause bridge 98efaa9e and the interface 'contingents are concrete' a1a00ab5. Neither bridge relabels B2: B2 holds without the existence PSR and without BX1 (controls 4c79358e, models 5-6); every premise of both bundles has an omission model and each bundle a nonvacuity model. The brute-contingency rival b36104ba is recorded at B2's scope (same frame, world, CAUSE_2) as alternative_to B2 and to 608a262d, restricted to the brute contingent foundation and witnessed by the First Way's mover in bruteFirst. No recorded independent justification for it reaches B2's scope; its entailed denials (weighing only as much as the denied open premises) are contingent existence coverage at w, the contingent-fact PSR there, a member of each support bundle, and the brute horn of the #746 fork; EvidenceBridge is only a conditional cost. The owner's parity argument (refined 2026-11-23) is formalized over a #756 stance extended by an ontic demand (WhyStance). 6e7f5afd: P3, P1, P2 give that the stance cannot accept a fact as a brute contingent truth; for a necessary fact this holds vacuously. The symmetric form 8fba6dd2 gives 9df516be, that the stance cannot accept a fact with no reason at all, binding a naturalist (target God) and a theist (target a contingent existent) alike; 117f8bc3 registers that 9df516be strengthens fbf3f3e0. The map a1056aab shows: both instances of the symmetric form; factive well-founded reasons always leave a truth unreasoned (#746 core reused), so a picture with nothing unexplained needs reasons that are not well-founded (a self-reason, a circle or an infinite chain; in the scene a self-reason); scene-relative tallies of unexplained existents per picture, which rank nothing by themselves (#746 count control); the self-explained God and base pictures agree in the arena; evidence for an existent is no reason why it exists, so the evidential stance is no exit and the argument does not answer the evidential question; stances bound (reason-status ground) and not bound (evidential, symmetric, idleness); under BX1 an own-nature token excludes contingency, so deriving God's noncontingency from it needs BX1's God instance, which under the essence = esse reading (natureModel, BX1 at w iff B6 at w) is B6's instance at God; noncontingency supplied otherwise also suffices; adequacy of the self-reason is a separate open question.

Retrospective proof-coverage audit, issue #2103 slice 1. Analyst formulations with attribution deferred. (a) Local existence coverage plus BX1 and BX2 gives B2 (608a262d, 6c6191dc, 0e44041e to 8a8d00e9, argument a8823bd2, result 7bf9cb77, BruteContingencyParity.esseCauseFromExistenceReasons). The proof extracts a #312 token, proves its source is distinct, then applies BX2. The grounding bundle (argument d82b02af, result 19260537, esseCauseFromGroundingClosure) takes concreteness, selected grounding closure and its esse-cause bridge. The external-token result 093cc339 (argument 204098e1, ExternalExistenceReason.distinctCause) weakens the BX1 burden to one external token while retaining coverage and BX2. The B2 consumer is FirstMoverNecessity.firstMoverNecessaryByEsseCause (8cc169e3) on the God-existence ancestry. The load-bearing definitions are e7302a28 (local existence PSR), d513fb8a (reason token), 97f37f5c (contingency) and 211a6432 (esse cause). (a) Parity results 6e7f5afd and 8fba6dd2 (arguments e18d19fd and 80377758, conclusions fbf3f3e0 and 9df516be) transport the ontic demand requiresWhy across one shared feature and use WhyHonors to exclude the brute or unreasoned acceptance. They do not infer B2 or the epistemic defeat of a rival. PSRSelfApplication.bridgeLadder (1d85f7af, argument 33136812) derives the consequences of the EvidenceBridge and GlobalDefeat conditions for their own typed support relation. (e) There is no bound judgment ranking a self-explained God over a stable primitive impersonal foundation. The #1910 comparison (attempt 9d7b8ae0, owned by slice 0) distinguishes adequate existence coverage E from determining coverage D. Its narrower same-member and selection controls have typed coverage in ContainedSelection.exerciseComparison and restrictionBoundary (31a48b76, 9a2c5f49). These controls preserve the substantive gap from adequate existential tokens to determining reasons, modal recombination or epistemic warrant.
blocker:
No premise is established, and neither parity form supports B2 or God's existence. The owner's comparative claim (one self-explained terminus explains existence better than unexplained contingents) rests on an open comparative principle (#750 adequacy norm) and the open adequacy of a self-reason, not on the tallies. Open: warrant for BX1 and BX2 (BX2's rival: non-causing occasions as reasons for contingent existence, model 3); contingent abstracta under the concreteness interface; circles and an endless regress of contingents are not in the scene (whole-series question, #755 collapse core, a5958e25). No strengthens relation from STMT-NO-BRUTE-EXISTENCE-AT to 608a262d: a new argument with that premise fails the sense check because the existing statement links both senses of BRUTE_EXISTENCE_FACT_VERSUS_GROUNDING_BRUTE. Next tests: (1) whether the necessary-root uniqueness and attributes results discriminate a self-explained God from a self-explained necessary physical base at matching scope; (2) derive BX1's God instance from contingent irreflexivity plus B6, or from another noncontingency route; (3) a regress picture with the whole-series standards; (4) a treatment or restriction of B2 for contingent abstracta.

Next distinct audit test. At one contingent bearer, compare an independently defended noncausing existential reason and a productive existential reason on the same adequacy standard. This could inform BX2 and E without presupposing D. For the parity argument, identify a defended feature and demand shared by both packages, and examine adequacy of the proposed self-reason at the terminal bearer.
